text.p: These are the headlines selected from Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ontario reaches deal with MDs: Payments clawback to be cancelled; fees for services to rise in each year of three-year pack.
- Youth left out of jobs, study says: Good education no guarantee.
- Province planning to divide Hydro: Electricity market would open up.
- Chretien may spread cash over floodwaters: Liberal strategist try to decide whether visit to Manitoba will shore up PM's eroded popularity.
- Deal creates oil rig giant: National-Oilwell of Texas acquiring Canada's Dreco in $510-million share swap amid frenzied drilling
- Gandalf loss in quarter its worst yet: Revenue tumbles, credit line slashed.
- Buckeye wins fight to buy Merfin: $210-million bid trumps Polymer.
- Java junkies to get jolted -- by prices: Coffee futures nearly triple 1996 levels; could hit 20-year high with frost in Brazil.
- CP Rail links up with U.S. railway: Deal with Norfold Southern to give it bigger share of cross-border market.
- Rebel group routs Russel directors: Chief executive and five board members forced to step down.
- National Oil makes US$442M play for Dreco.
